searchText: EIP-8411: I've published a new post with more simulations: - rerunning most things under the Shadow simulator; - reproducing several results under pure Linux processes + bandwidth limits + latency. 2 main messages: - everything is fine, everything works, delay and bandwidth advantage holds - simulators live on abstractions, and those show in results. Particularly Shadow seems to be not ideal (in the sense of mapping to reality) in this case. But all this doesn't really matter, because it is not about the exact numbers, but the extent of the performance gains https://ethresear.ch/t/eip-8411-payload-segmentation-under-the-shadow-simulator/26070 A thread for [#5509](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5509)

EIP-8411: I've published a new post with more simulations:
- rerunning most things under the Shadow simulator;
- reproducing several results under pure Linux processes + bandwidth limits + latency. 

2 main messages:
- everything is fine, everything works, delay and bandwidth advantage holds
- simulators live on abstractions, and those show in results. Particularly Shadow seems to be not ideal (in the sense of mapping to reality) in this case. But all this doesn't really matter, because it is not about the exact numbers, but the extent of the performance gains
